# 0) Preprocessing:

```{r}
# Read the dataset with all variables:
df_1=read.csv("../data/ukb_all_vars.csv")
colnames(df_1)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
# Subset only european ancestry individuals (white):
white= c("British", "Irish", "Any other white background")
df_1=df_1[ df_1$ethnicity %in% white, ]

table(df_1$ethnicity)
```



## a) Assign NA to all values different than the measurements:

```{r}
# Columns to inspect the structure looking for misslabeled NA:
cols_na= c("depression", "s_phys_abus", "s_sex_mol", "s_felt_loved", "s_felt_hated", "s_neglect", "s_loneliness" , "cf_pairs_match_1", "cf_num_memory", "cf_num_memory_ONL", "cf_tm_duration_num", "cf_tm_duration_num_ONL", "cf_tm_duration_alph" , "cf_tm_duration_alph_ONL", "cf_fluid_intell", "cf_fluid_intell_ONL", "cf_paired_aso_learn", "cf_reaction_time", "cf_matrix_pattern", "cf_tower_rearranging", "cf_symb_digit_subst", "cf_symb_digit_subst_ONL")

lapply(df_1[, cols_na], unique)

```


```{r}

####### 1) All stressor vairiables:
# Childhood abuse:
stressors_CH= c("s_phys_abus", "s_sex_mol", "s_sex_mol", "s_felt_loved", "s_felt_hated")
unique(df_1$s_sex_mol) # as example

for (stressor in stressors_CH) {
  df_1[[stressor]][(df_1[[stressor]] %in% -818)] = NA
}
unique(df_1$s_sex_mol)

# Neglect: 
df_1 <- df_1 %>% 
  mutate(
    s_neglect = case_when(
      s_neglect == "Never true" ~ 0,
      s_neglect == "Rarely true"  ~ 1,
      s_neglect == "Sometimes true" ~ 2,
      s_neglect == "Often" ~ 3,
      s_neglect == "Very often true"~ 4,
      s_neglect %in% c("", "Prefer not to answer") |
        is.na(s_neglect)                     ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

unique(df_1$s_neglect)

# Loneliness-AD:
df_1$s_loneliness[df_1$s_loneliness %in% c("Prefer not to answer", "Do not know", "")] = NA
unique(df_1$s_loneliness)




####### 2) Covariates:
# Physical activity:
unique(df_1$phys_act)
df_1$phys_act[(df_1$phys_act %in% c(-1, -3 ) )] = NA
unique(df_1$phys_act)

# Depression:
unique(df_1$depression)
df_1$depression[(df_1$depression %in% c("Do not know", "Prefer not to answer", "" ) )] = NA
unique(df_1$depression)
df_1$depression= as.factor(df_1$depression)
str(df_1$depression)
```


```{r}
####### 3) Cognitive functions: 
# NOTE: ONLINE CFs-versions are already cleaned.

##### Assign NA to numeric memory:  
unique(df_1$cf_num_memory)
df_1$cf_num_memory[(df_1$cf_num_memory %in% c("Abandoned", "" ) )] = NA
#Change the structure from string to numeric:
df_1$cf_num_memory=as.integer(df_1$cf_num_memory)
unique(df_1$cf_num_memory)

#### Assign NA to trail_making_dur:  
# Numeric (trail a)
unique(df_1$cf_tm_duration_num)
df_1$cf_tm_duration_num[(df_1$cf_tm_duration_num %in% c("Trail not completed", "" ) )] = NA
unique(df_1$cf_tm_duration_num)
# Change the structure from string to numeric:
df_1$cf_tm_duration_num=as.numeric(df_1$cf_tm_duration_num)
unique(df_1$cf_tm_duration_num)

# Alphanumeric (trail b)
unique(df_1$cf_tm_duration_alph)
df_1$cf_tm_duration_alph[(df_1$cf_tm_duration_alph%in% c("Trail not completed", "" ) )] = NA
unique(df_1$cf_tm_duration_alph)
# Change the structure from string to numeric:
df_1$cf_tm_duration_alph=as.numeric(df_1$cf_tm_duration_alph)
unique(df_1$cf_tm_duration_alph)

```


```{r}
# Factor and dummy variables:
df_1$sex=as.factor(df_1$sex)

# Change the levels of the stressor Loneliness:
df_1 <- df_1 %>% 
  mutate(
    s_loneliness = case_when(
      tolower(as.character(s_loneliness)) == "yes" ~ 1L,
      tolower(as.character(s_loneliness)) == "no"  ~ 0L,
      TRUE  ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )

# Check final structure: 
str(df_1)
```

## c) Creation of pooled / compound variables: 

### CFs:
### - Change units of duplicated CFs:

- Both cf_num_memory (centre and online) have the same scale.
- Both cf_fluid_intell (centre and online) have the same scale.
- Both cf_symb_digit_subst (centre and online) have the same scale.

```{r}

### A) cf_tm_duration_num:
# Convert Centre-version of "cf_tm_duration_num" from deciseconds to seconds (to match the online version units)
summary(df_1$cf_tm_duration_num)
summary(df_1$cf_tm_duration_num_ONL)

df_1$cf_tm_duration_num = df_1$cf_tm_duration_num / 10

cat("After conversion to seconds: \n")
summary(df_1$cf_tm_duration_num)
```

```{r}
### B) cf_tm_duration_alph:
# Convert Centre-version of "cf_tm_duration_alph" from deciseconds to seconds (to match the online version units)
summary(df_1$cf_tm_duration_alph)
summary(df_1$cf_tm_duration_alph_ONL)

df_1$cf_tm_duration_alph = df_1$cf_tm_duration_alph / 10

cat("After conversion to seconds: \n")
summary(df_1$cf_tm_duration_alph)


```




### - Pooled CFs:
##### .Center + online versions:

```{r}
###### 1) Create the pooled variables for CFs with centre+online data available: 
library(dplyr)
df_1 <- df_1 %>%
  mutate(cf_num_memory_MERG = coalesce(cf_num_memory_ONL, cf_num_memory),
         cf_tm_duration_num_MERG = coalesce(cf_tm_duration_num_ONL, cf_tm_duration_num),
         cf_tm_duration_alph_MERG = coalesce(cf_tm_duration_alph_ONL, cf_tm_duration_alph),
         cf_fluid_intell_MERG = coalesce(cf_fluid_intell_ONL, cf_fluid_intell),
         cf_symb_digit_subst_MERG = coalesce(cf_symb_digit_subst_ONL, cf_symb_digit_subst),
         ) 
#@ coalesce()= returns the first non-NA value it finds in each row (first looking at online and then at centre variable)

# Valid data in final variables:
sum(!is.na(df_1$cf_num_memory_MERG))
sum(!is.na(df_1$cf_tm_duration_num_MERG))
sum(!is.na(df_1$cf_tm_duration_alph_MERG))
sum(!is.na(df_1$cf_fluid_intell_MERG))
sum(!is.na(df_1$cf_symb_digit_subst_MERG))

```


```{r}
#### 2) Create new dataset with new cf variables: 
exc_vars_df2= c("cf_num_memory", "cf_num_memory_ONL", "cf_tm_duration_num", "cf_tm_duration_num_ONL", "cf_tm_duration_alph" , "cf_tm_duration_alph_ONL", "cf_fluid_intell", "cf_fluid_intell_ONL", "cf_symb_digit_subst", "cf_symb_digit_subst_ONL")
df_2= df_1[, !colnames(df_1) %in% exc_vars_df2]
colnames(df_2)
```


##### .Create the Attention Switching var:

```{r}
### 1) Create the attention switching variable: 
# NOTE: This is going to be (Duration to complete alphanumeric path (trail #2) / Duration to complete numeric path (trail #1))
df_2$cf_att_swit= df_2$cf_tm_duration_alph_MERG / df_2$cf_tm_duration_num_MERG
sum(!is.na(df_2$cf_att_swit))

```

###- Reverse the CFs that need to: 

Because more seconds = slower = worse, I multiply *Trail-Making (A and B)* and *Reaction time* times by -1 so that higher is better

```{r}
### Reverse variables with units=seconds: 
summary(df_2$cf_tm_duration_num_MERG)
# Reverse Trail #1 (A):
df_2$cf_tm_duration_num_MERG = df_2$cf_tm_duration_num_MERG * -1
# Reverse Trail #2 (B):
df_2$cf_tm_duration_alph_MERG = df_2$cf_tm_duration_alph_MERG * -1
# Reverse Reaction time:
df_2$cf_reaction_time = df_2$cf_reaction_time * -1

summary(df_2$cf_tm_duration_num_MERG)

```

### - Compound Zscore CFs creation:


```{r}
###### Create compound Z-scores for the CF domains:
### A) zscore_processing_speed: 
  
df_2 <- df_2 %>%
## 1) Create Z-scores for each task (single CF):
  mutate(
    z_reac_time      = as.numeric(scale(cf_reaction_time)), # use scale to standardise
    z_symb_d_sub  = as.numeric(scale(cf_symb_digit_subst_MERG)),   
  ) %>%
    
## 2) Create the compound score by computing the mean of the available single CF z-scores within each row:
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Count non-missing tasks (CFs):
    n_avail_PS = sum(!is.na(c_across(z_reac_time:z_symb_d_sub))), 
    # Average the z-scores present:
    PS_raw     = ifelse(n_avail_PS >= 2, # only if at least 2 values present
                        mean(c_across(z_reac_time:z_symb_d_sub), na.rm = TRUE),
                        NA_real_) # else leave as NA
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% # return to normal (non-rowwise)
    
## 3) Re-standardise the composite score, so it is also a z-score:
  mutate(
    cf_zscore_processing_speed = as.numeric(scale(PS_raw))
  ) %>%
# Drop intermediate variables (helpers):
  dplyr::select(-n_avail_PS, -PS_raw)
  
  
head(df_2)

```


```{r}
### B) zscore_reasoning: 
  
df_2 <- df_2 %>%
## 1) Create Z-scores for each task (single CF):
  mutate(
    z_flidint  = as.numeric(scale(cf_fluid_intell_MERG)), # use scale to standardise
    z_matpat  = as.numeric(scale(cf_matrix_pattern))
  ) %>%
    
## 2) Create the compound score by computing the mean of the available single CF z-scores within each row:
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Count non-missing tasks (CFs):
    n_avail_R = sum(!is.na(c_across(z_flidint:z_matpat))), 
    # Average the z-scores present:
    R_raw  = ifelse(n_avail_R >= 2, # only if at least 2 values present
                        mean(c_across(z_flidint:z_matpat), na.rm = TRUE),
                        NA_real_) # else leave as NA
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% # return to normal (non-rowwise)
    
## 3) Re-standardise the composite score, so it is also a z-score:
  mutate(
    cf_zscore_reasoning = as.numeric(scale(R_raw))
  ) %>%
# Drop intermediate variables (helpers):
  dplyr::select(-n_avail_R, -R_raw)
  
  
head(df_2)
```


```{r}
### C) zscore_executive_function:

## 1) Create Z-scores for each task (single CF):
```

```{r}
### C) zscore_memory:
```

###- Visualization of missing data: 

```{r}
###### 1) Create VISS plots to visualize missing data:
library(naniar)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Number of chunks
n_chunks <- 30
chunk_size <- nrow(df_1) %/% n_chunks

# Directory to save plots
dir.create("missing_plots_df1", showWarnings = FALSE)

# Split and save each plot

for (i in 1:3) { ## Only create 3 plots for the first 3 chunks
  cat("Saving chunk", i, "\n")
  
  df_chunk <- df_1 %>%
    slice(((i - 1) * chunk_size + 1):(i * chunk_size))
  
  p <- vis_miss(df_chunk)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("missing_plots_df1/df_1_vis_miss_chunk_", i, ".png"),
    plot = p,
    width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300
  )
}


```

### Stress categories:


```{r}
# Category - Physical abuse=
df_2$s_phys_abus_CAT= df_2$s_phys_abus + df_2$s_sex_mol
table(df_2$s_phys_abus_CAT)

# Category - Psychological/emotional abuse= 
df_2$s_psy_abus_CAT= df_2$s_felt_loved + df_2$s_felt_hated
table(df_2$s_psy_abus_CAT)
```

```{r}
#### Collapse the last levels of stress to increase sample size of the highest stress level: 
stressors_CAT= c("s_phys_abus_CAT", "s_psy_abus_CAT") 
stressors_sing= c("s_phys_abus", "s_sex_mol", "s_felt_loved", "s_felt_hated", "s_neglect",  "s_loneliness" )

# Loop through categorical stressors
for (stressor in stressors_CAT) {
  cat("\nBefore collapsing:", stressor, "\n")
  print(table(df_2[[stressor]]))

  # Collapse levels >= 4 to 4
  df_2[[stressor]] <- ifelse(df_2[[stressor]] >= 4, 4, df_2[[stressor]])

  cat("After collapsing:", stressor, "\n")
  print(table(df_2[[stressor]]))
}


# Loop through single stressors
for (stressor in stressors_sing) {
  cat("\nBefore collapsing: ", stressor, "\n")
  print(table(df_2[[stressor]]))

  # Collapse levels >= 3 to 3
  df_2[[stressor]] <- ifelse(df_2[[stressor]] >= 3, 3, df_2[[stressor]])

  cat("After collapsing:", stressor, "\n")
  print(table(df_2[[stressor]]))
}




```

## f) Update and Save the subsets: 

### - Update subsets:

```{r}
##### 4) Update the 21 (single CFs) and the 14 (zscores CFs) subsets only including the complete cases: 
# List of subsets: 
subsets= c("df_CRP_1pairsm_rt","df_CRP_2trailm_as","df_CRP_3matpat_pal","df_CRP_4numem","df_CRP_5fluidin","df_CRP_6symbds","df_CRP_7towerre","df_IL6_1pairsm_rt","df_IL6_2trailm_as","df_IL6_3matpat_pal","df_IL6_4numem","df_IL6_5fluidin","df_IL6_6symbds","df_IL6_7towerre",  "df_IBs_1pairsm_rt","df_IBs_2trailm_as","df_IBs_3matpat_pal","df_IBs_4numem","df_IBs_5fluidin","df_IBs_6symbds","df_IBs_7towerre",  "df_CRP_1_zscore_processing_speed","df_CRP_2_zscore_reasoning","df_CRP_3_zscore_executive_function","df_CRP_4_zscore_memory", "df_IL6_1_zscore_processing_speed","df_IL6_2_zscore_reasoning","df_IL6_3_zscore_executive_function","df_IL6_4_zscore_memory", "df_IBs_1_zscore_processing_speed","df_IBs_2_zscore_reasoning","df_IBs_3_zscore_executive_function","df_IBs_4_zscore_memory" )

for (subset in subsets) {
  df <- get(subset)  # Get each dataframe
  df_clean <- df[complete.cases(df), ]   # Keep only complete cases
  assign(subset, df_clean, envir = .GlobalEnv)  # Save it back to the same variable
}

str(df_2)
```



```{r}
### Check missing data of ONE of the datasets for mediations with the other 3 IBS:
# Number of chunks
n_chunks <- 15
chunk_size <- nrow(df_IBs_4numem) %/% n_chunks

# Directory to save plots
dir.create("missing_plots_dfIBs_4numem", showWarnings = FALSE)

# Split and save each plot
for (i in 1:3) { ## Only create 3 plots for the first 3 chunks
  cat("Saving chunk", i, "\n")
  
  df_chunk <- df_IBs_4numem %>%
    slice(((i - 1) * chunk_size + 1):(i * chunk_size))
  
  p <- vis_miss(df_chunk)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("missing_plots_dfIBs_4numem/vis_miss_chunk_dfIBs_4numem_", i, ".png"),
    plot = p,
    width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300
  )
}
```
